Question ID: Q032
Question: Which regions have more than one asset?

missing_value_hints: GROUP BY the requested entity and use HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rank_trace.sql:
SELECT l.region, COUNT(a.asset_id) AS asset_count
   FROM locations l
   JOIN assets a ON l.location_id = a.location_id
   GROUP BY l.region
   HAVING COUNT(a.asset_id) > 1
   ORDER BY l.region;
